hero.title: Central Tiffin Room: Bengaluru's Enduring Culinary Legacy
hero.subtitle: For over a century, Central Tiffin Room has been the heart of Old Bengaluru, serving its iconic Benne Dose and timeless South Indian delicacies. Taste the tradition that unites generations.

about.title: Central Tiffin Room: Where Tradition Meets Taste
about.paragraph1: Central Tiffin Room (CTR), a name synonymous with heritage and exceptional taste, has been deeply rooted in the heart of Old Bengaluru since 1920. For over a century, Central Tiffin Room has proudly served generations with its iconic Dosas, fluffy Idlis, and a delightful array of South Indian delicacies. We are 'The Emotion That Holds Old Bengaluru Together,' a cherished tradition that continues to bring joy to patrons of all ages.
about.paragraph2: At Central Tiffin Room, our commitment to culinary mastery is a legacy passed down through time. Famed for crafting 'Bengaluru’s Best Benne Dose,' our 104-year-old eatery retains its original charm and the exact taste that has captivated palates for decades. From the visionary Subramanyam brothers to the current 3rd Generation torchbearers, Mr. Sandesh Poojari and Ganesh S Poojari, Central Tiffin Room ensures every dish embodies cherished tradition and the boundless love of our loyal patrons.
